title: A bluff catcher below the broadway draws
explanation: Study how value hands and missed low-card bluffs mix against one-pair calls. Original POK educational study. Assumption-dependent weighted ranges, not solver-approved preflop ranges. Weighted assumptions and restricted sizes define this study; it is not a full-game solution. The independent LP verifies the same finite game.

result.completionReason: Requested iteration budget finished and reported gap meets target.

metric.name: NashConv
metric.definition: BR0(average policy1) + BR1(average policy0); centered zero-sum chips. Half is two-player exploitability. Relative percent = half / initial pot * 100. Only this restricted tree and weighted model.

result.reproducibility: Deterministic single-thread river traversal, no chance sampling/seed. Float rounding is runtime-dependent.
limitations: Heads-up river only; no chance nodes, rake, side pots or multistreet solution.
Discrete configured bets and at most one full raise; omitted sizes are not solved.
Old unmaintained upstream solver with float arithmetic; independent quality gates determine readiness.
Iteration budget is not a convergence certificate; displayed metric requires oracle validation.
Weights are proportionally normalized per seat, then represented as upstream float values; tiny numeric differences are expected.
Action EV uses average-policy continuation, relative to an equal split of the initial pot; past bets are not charged again.
Zero-reach nodes use declared initial opponent range fallback. A global gap is not a per-hand error bound.
External Java CFR traversal/trainable/best response; adapter tree, range boundary and independent five-card comparator.

verification.method: Independent PokerKit + SciPy HiGHS sequence-form LP and exact best responses
